messages:
maria p: Quick planning thread — want to build a compact customer playbook for the Upscale launch that includes: a one-pager decision flow, 2–3 micro-testimonials (text + 30s clips), a launch social post, and a webinar quote. Need to lock approvals & lead routing by EOD Friday.
leah content: ✅ I can draft the one-pager and social copy. Sharing a starter doc in 10m: https://docs.google.com/example-playbook (please comment).
sam p: For the benchmark narrative, let's highlight the 2x latency improvement and the 40% cost per token reduction. Need to confirm those numbers are safe to publish w/ legal. Sample tweet: "Upscale cut inference cost by ~40% while keeping 99ms median latency — real customer story."
elaine legal: Small flag — we need signed quote release from the customer before we publish percentages tied to them. Also prefer relative language rather than raw $ amounts. I can draft a 1-paragraph release for signature.
ryan cs: I can book 15–20m interviews with the customer champions. Prefer scheduled slots Tue/Wed next week. I'll collect 3 short quotables and ask for a 30s Loom clip. I have a Google form I send for permissions; will attach to the doc.
devin design: For clips: 1080p, vertical/landscape options, background logo plate optional. If they only do audio, we can produce a subtitle card + waveform. I'll make a quick template and drop it in the doc.
nick sales: Routing question — when the launch social/webinar goes live, can we auto-tag inbound leads that mention Upscale on the demo form into the "ux-launch" SDR queue? If yes, set priority to high. Also want the playbook to include a canned demo script for SDRs.
maria p: Good call, @nick sales — yes route to ux-launch tag. @ryan cs can you coordinate with ops to make that tag active?
ryan cs: Yep, will set up a rule in HubSpot and add an internal field: "source: ux-playbook". Will confirm by Thursday.
leah content: Draft checklist (quick):
```
- create one-pager playbook
- confirm benchmarks & phrasing with Sam
- schedule 3x 20m interviews (Ryan)
- obtain signed quote + recording permissions (Elaine)
- capture 2x 30s clips + 3 text quotes (Devin/Ryan)
- legal sign-off on copy
- tag inbound leads and update SDR playbook (Nick)
- finalize social + webinar blurb
```
elaine legal: I have one suggested redline: remove any explicit revenue figures tied to the customer. Replace with % improvement or "reduced unit cost by ~40%" and add an attribution line. Also need the customer's PR contact cc'd on the release.
leah content: Noted. I'll remove raw $ and use relative phrasing. Adding PR contact field to the permission form.
maria p: Timeline check — Leah will finish draft by Wed noon, Elaine to review by Thu, Ryan to collect tapes by Thu EOD, Devin to produce assets Fri morning, final approvals Fri 5pm. Can everyone confirm? :eyes:
sam p: Confirmed from product side — I'll re-run the benchmark snippet with the production config and paste the query into the doc.
ryan cs: Confirmed — I have interview slots and will push permission forms.
devin design: Confirmed — will upload templates and export presets.
elaine legal: Will review and post a signature-ready release by Thu.
nick sales: Confirmed; will prep SDR script + routing instructions.
reminder-bot: Reminder set for "Playbook approvals due" on 2026-03-27 17:00. :bell:
maria p: Perfect. If anything blocks approvals ping me directly. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
